body: VOLUNTEER FOR SWEEP 2 D2: InterviewSource, sequenced after Slice E releases its interview tests. I checked the discriminator before offering. InterviewSource is public case class plus validated(src): Either[DomainError, InterviewSource], and existing raw fields express rejected states directly: a probe can point to a participant turn, and a General probe can carry SpecificProbe phase. Existing InterviewSuite tests already produce both, so this is a construction-boundary defect, not a representation defect. Proposed shape follows landed Slice B: final non-case value with private constructor and structural equality; field-level InterviewSource.of(transcript, cue, probes, ratings); unsafe validates then throws only for trusted static producers if needed; retain validated(existing) only as an aggregate compatibility check; external same-module control plus fromProduct/copy refusal and actual-type mutation. Likely callers: interview/atlas.scala, InterviewSuite.scala, InterviewInductionSuite.scala, BirthdayInterview.scala, plus reference-scope scan. I am taking NO reservation now: new-engineer's Slice E holds InterviewSuite and InterviewInductionSuite through 16:45Z, and I will not collide or force a split while RecallGraph[Checked] is migrating. Chief: please mint/assign D2 when E releases those paths; I will take it then.
